title: Harden validateShardShape to type-check optional fields (notes, description)
description:
lib/shard-library.mjs:484 validateShardShape currently only validates required fields (id, status, updated) and ISO-format of `updated`. Optional fields like `notes` and `description` are not type-checked, which means any writer (current or future) that produces a wrong-shape value (e.g. notes as array, description as object) silently writes invalid JSON to disk that fails downstream tasklist-rebuild validation.

Real-world incident: TASK-038 fixed buildClosedShard / buildLinkedClosedShard to coerce array-shaped notes to string. Both were correctly producing strings post-fix. But during a sprint-4 acceptance run against the issues-plugin repo on 2026-05-04 (before the TASK-038 deploy reached ~/.config/opencode/skills/orchestrator/), the OLD pre-coercion code wrote two task shards with `notes: ["..."]`. validateShardShape happily passed them through; tasklist-rebuild downstream rejected them; manual coercion + rebuild was required.

With TASK-038 deployed, this specific bug is fixed at the source. But validateShardShape remains a single-point-of-failure gap: any future writer (a new mutator, a third-party CLI, a half-completed refactor) that re-introduces a wrong shape for notes/description will repeat the same incident pattern. A 3-line type-check at the gate would have caught both occurrences immediately at the write point.

Scope is intentionally narrow: only type-check fields the shard schema/spec actually defines as optional strings. Don't try to validate the full schema here — that's tasklist-rebuild's job. This is just a defensive write-time guard.
acceptance_criteria: validateShardShape rejects shards where notes is present but not a string (with error code 'validation-error:bad-notes-type')
validateShardShape rejects shards where description is present but not a string (with error code 'validation-error:bad-description-type')
Missing notes/description still passes (they are optional)
Empty-string notes/description passes (vs the existing length>0 check on required fields)
Add unit test covering: (a) array notes throws, (b) object description throws, (c) missing optional fields pass, (d) string optional fields pass, (e) all existing required-field checks still pass
